system.description:
(Condition) The target is susceptible to Specter Rites. Lasts 1 minute or until removed. Unwilling targets can make a WIL save vs your Hero DC at the end of their turns for free to remove Soul Touched.

Soul Touched is a combat condition; outside combat it only enables your Rites. Each Specter's Soul Touched is tracked individually, as it can gain other effects (from Soul Sculpting techniques and subclass features). Constructs, Undead and "Soulless" creatures still have a soul the Specter can twist.

[A] Soul Twist marks the target with a visible “Soul Touched (your name)” effect (plus Nimble's Marked status icon) — delete that effect by hand to clear a mistake. At the end of each Soul Touched creature’s turn the module posts a WIL save button vs your Hero DC (Soothing and Soul of Suffering adjust it); a success removes the mark and applies Agony, Dissonance, Earthbind and Rotting Flesh (each with Undo).

[M] Rupture’s damage to adjacent enemies is shown on the save card; apply it by hand. Condition durations and the 1-minute limit are tracked by hand.
